title: Feature catalog registry (features/registry.json, D12)
description: Producer: features/registry.py::generate_registry_json/upload_registry, a serialization of CATALOG (list[FeatureEntry]). Consumer: crucible-dashboard views/13_Feature_Store.py::_load_registry (data-collector plan P-07, alpha-engine-config-I10870, D12). The per-COLUMN contract for features/{date}/*.parquet remains features/registry.py::CATALOG <-> features/SCHEMA.md §3 (tests/test_schema_contract.py) — this schema covers only the SEPARATE S3-published registry.json artifact the dashboard actually GETs, which had no versioned JSON Schema of its own before this PR.
